heading: Close the gap. Build confidence.
forWhom: For children in primary grades · Std I–V
intro: Some children fall behind not because they can't, but because a few foundational gaps were never quite filled. The Bridge Program is focused, individualised support that finds those gaps and closes them — in Math, in Language, and in the confidence to take part. It is assessment-led and goal-driven, not a tuition class.

steps.title: Free Skill-Gap Assessment
steps.description: Every child begins with a pre-screening assessment against the national NCF–NIPUN framework, across Math, Language and Social & Communication skills. It is free, with no obligation to enrol.

steps.title: A clear picture of the gaps
steps.description: We map exactly where your child's understanding has gaps — and, just as importantly, where their strengths already are.

steps.title: An individual plan (IEP)
steps.description: Based on the assessment, we build an Individualised Education Plan for the areas your child actually needs, and review it as they progress.

bridgesHeading: Three bridges, chosen to fit your child

bridges.name: Math Bridge
bridges.description: Rebuilds confidence with numbers from the ground up — developing genuine, foundational understanding of key Math concepts, not rote drilling.

bridges.name: Language Bridge
bridges.description: Strengthens the foundational structure of the English language — vocabulary, comprehension, reading and writing — so your child can learn, and express, with confidence.

bridges.name: Social & Communication Skills
bridges.description: Builds the confidence to take part in group settings — turn-taking, conversation, managing feelings and making friends. Included free of charge for every child enrolled in a Math or Language Bridge.

whyHeading: Why parents choose the Bridge Program
why: A free NCF–NIPUN skill-gap assessment for every child
A maximum of 4 children per cohort
Guided by an in-house psychologist and special educators
An Individualised Education Plan (IEP) for every child
A measurable skill gradient, so progress is visible, not guessed
Focused remediation — this is not a tuition class
alignmentNote: Assessment and goals are mapped to India's NCF Foundational Stage and the NIPUN Bharat foundational literacy & numeracy framework.
